name: Parliament Library Building
features: Kept low beside the round Parliament House, with courtyards and a central steel-and-glass dome.

name: L. D. Institute of Indology
features: Concrete pavilion with a cantilevered upper floor and deep shaded verandahs guarding old manuscripts.

name: British Council, New Delhi
features: An axis through layered courts; Howard Hodgkin's banyan tree in black and white stone spans the facade.

name: National Crafts Museum
features: Village-like cluster of low pavilions along a meandering open-air street of courtyards.
image: शिल्प कला कौशल कार्यक्रम का क्षेत्र.JPG

name: Kala Academy
features: Pergola-shaded walkways and an open-air amphitheatre beside the Mandovi river.

name: Jeevan Bharati Building
features: Two red sandstone and glass blocks linked by a giant pergola that frames a plaza on Connaught Place.

name: Villa Sarabhai
features: Parallel Catalan brick vaults on bearing walls, with a grass roof and a slide down into the pool.

name: Open Hand Monument
features: Sheet-metal hand that turns in the wind above a sunken amphitheatre, the Trench of Consideration.

name: Wall House
features: Exposed brick walls and roofs of hollow terracotta tubes, an experiment in low-energy local building.

name: Palmyra House
features: Two timber volumes screened by louvres cut from palmyra palm trunks, set in a coconut grove.

name: Embassy of Belgium, New Delhi
features: Sculpted brick and granite forms half sunk into landscaped mounds, like an excavated ruin.
image: Embassy of Belgium in New Delhi.jpg

name: Triveni Kala Sangam
features: Galleries, studios and an open-air theatre around planted courtyards, screened by jali walls.

name: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Stadium
features: Folded-plate concrete roof cantilevered over the stands, the structure left fully on show.

name: Bihar Museum
features: Low weathering-steel-clad pavilions linked around courtyards and gardens that keep old trees on site.

name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport Terminal 2
features: Coffered roof on tall mushroom columns, pierced by skylights in a peacock-feather pattern.

name: Taj Mahal
features: White marble tomb on a raised plinth at the end of a quartered garden, framed by four minarets.

name: Badshahi Mosque
features: Red sandstone prayer hall with three marble domes facing a vast courtyard ringed by minarets.
image: Badshahi Mosque July 1 2005 pic32 by Ali Imran (1).jpg

name: Pakistan Monument
features: Four large and three small granite petals open in a ring, their inner faces carved with murals.

name: Minar-e-Pakistan
features: Tapering concrete tower rising from a flower-shaped base of stepped platforms, set in a large park.

name: Friendship Hospital Satkhira
features: Brick wards set along a rain-fed canal that runs through the hospital, cooling its courtyards.

name: Shaheed Minar, Dhaka
features: Slender white frames on a stepped platform, the central one bowed like a mother over her children.

name: Anandaloy
features: Mud and bamboo centre with a ramp winding round its walls, built by hand with local craftspeople.

name: Baitul Mukarram
features: Domeless cubic prayer hall recalling the Kaaba, raised on a broad podium in the city centre.
image: Baitul Mukarram (Arabic, بيت المكرّم; Bengali, বায়তুল মুকাররম; The Holy House).jpg

name: Heritance Ahungalla
features: Open lobby framing a long pool that seems to run straight on into the sea.

name: Jetwing Lighthouse
features: Hotel on a rocky headland; its spiral stair winds round Laki Senanayake's bronze battle sculpture.
image: Ocean view from Galle Light House Hotel, Sri Lanka.jpg

name: Independence Memorial Hall
features: Open pillared hall under a tiered Kandyan roof, modelled on a royal audience hall.

name: Punakha Dzong
features: Whitewashed fortress-monastery where two rivers meet, with tiered timber roofs over its courtyards.

name: Hukuru Miskiy
features: Mosque of interlocking carved coral stone blocks, with a lacquered and carved timber interior.

name: Nyatapola
features: Five-tiered pagoda on a five-stepped plinth, its stair lined with pairs of guardian figures.

name: Oasia Hotel Downtown
features: Tower wrapped in red aluminium mesh grown over with creepers, opened up by breezy sky gardens.

name: School of the Arts, Singapore
features: Teaching blocks above a public podium of theatres, with green walls and shaded breezeways.

name: People's Park Complex
features: Shopping podium with a central atrium 'city room' below a long slab block of flats.

name: Singapore Conference Hall
features: Glazed hall under a broad overhanging roof, with sunshading fins along its facades.

name: National Library Building
features: Two blocks linked by bridges round a shaded open atrium, with sun-shading blades and sky gardens.

name: Supertree Grove
features: Steel tree-shaped towers clad in living plants, joined by a high walkway.
image: Supertree Grove, Gardens by the Bay, Singapore - 20120712-02.jpg

name: Helix Bridge
features: Footbridge framed by two stainless-steel helices wound round each other like DNA.
image: Puente Helix, Marina Bay, Singapur, 2023-08-16, DD 144-146 HDR.jpg

name: ArtScience Museum
features: Lotus-like ring of curved 'fingers' with skylights at their tips, set over a lily pond.

name: LASALLE College of the Arts
features: Dark-clad blocks split around a central void whose inner walls are faced in glass.
image: City Campus of LASALLE College of the Arts, Singapore - 20080620.jpg

name: The Hive, Nanyang Technological University
features: Cluster of rounded towers of tutorial rooms around a central atrium, in textured concrete.

name: CapitaSpring
features: Tower of vertical fins that part at mid-height around a spiralling open-air garden.

name: Malaysian Houses of Parliament
features: Tower with a grid of precast sunscreens beside a low hall under a crown of triangular roofs.
image: Kuala Lumpur Malaysia Bangunan Parlimen Malaysia-02.jpg

name: Menara Tabung Haji
features: Round tower held by five external columns, its form drawn from a drum and the five pillars of Islam.

name: National Museum (Malaysia)
features: Long hall under a tall Malay-style roof, its front decorated with large mosaic murals.

name: Menara UMNO
features: Slim tower with wing walls that catch the wind and steer it into the floors for natural cooling.

name: Potato Head Beach Club
features: Curved wall clad in hundreds of reclaimed wooden window shutters, wrapping a lawn and pool.

name: Kampung Kali Code
features: Riverbank houses of bamboo and timber, built and painted with residents of a squatter settlement.

name: National Monument (Indonesia)
features: Tall obelisk tipped with a gilded flame, rising from a square platform in Merdeka Square.

name: Al-Irsyad Mosque
features: Cube of stacked blocks whose gaps spell out the shahada, filtering daylight into the hall.

name: House for Trees
features: Concrete boxes like giant plant pots with trees on their roofs, grouped around a small courtyard.

name: Bamboo Wing
features: Bamboo roof spreading like a bird's wing from bundled bamboo columns, built without steel.

name: Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum
features: Grey granite block on a stepped base with a portico of square columns, facing Ba Dinh Square.

name: Bitexco Financial Tower
features: Tapering glass tower shaped like a lotus bud, with a helipad cantilevered from its upper floors.
image: Bitexco Financial Tower in morning sunlight.jpg

name: Hanoi Museum
features: Inverted stepped pyramid, each floor wider than the one below, around a spiralling ramp.

name: Elephant Building
features: Three towers joined at the top to read as an elephant, with round windows for eyes.

name: Bangkok Art and Culture Centre
features: Galleries ringed around a tall circular atrium climbed by a spiralling ramp.
image: Bangkok Art and Culture Centre building.jpg

name: Suvarnabhumi Airport
features: Vast steel-truss roof over the terminal; concourses covered in translucent membrane panels.

name: Jim Thompson House
features: Old teak houses moved and joined on stilts beside a canal, in a dense tropical garden.
image: Main House of Jim Thompson photo Don Ramey Logan.jpg

name: Chulalongkorn University Centenary Park
features: Tilted park that gathers rainwater into wetlands and a retention lawn to ease city flooding.

name: Philippine International Convention Center
features: Long horizontal concrete mass that seems to float over a recessed glazed base.

name: EDSA Shrine
features: Church raised on a public plaza at a city crossroads, crowned by a bronze statue of Mary.

name: San Miguel Corporation Building
features: Office block wrapped in stepped planted terraces and deep sunshades, a tropical take on the tower.

name: Quezon Memorial Shrine
features: Three tall pylons topped by winged figures, over a museum and the president's mausoleum.
image: Allan Jay Quesada Quezon Monument DSC 2689.jpg

name: Chaktomuk Conference Hall
features: Fan-shaped hall on the riverfront, its plan opening out like a palm leaf toward the water.

name: Independence Monument (Cambodia)
features: Lotus-shaped tower in the form of an Angkorian temple spire, layered with naga heads.

name: Wat Xieng Thong
features: Temple hall whose layered roofs sweep almost to the ground, with gilded and glass-mosaic walls.

name: Ananda Temple
features: Cross-plan brick temple; high hidden openings light four standing Buddhas from above.

name: Kempegowda International Airport Terminal 2
features: A terminal set in gardens, with bamboo-clad ceilings and hanging plants through the halls.

name: Folk Arts Theater
features: Wide amphitheatre under a broad, low concrete roof that seems to hover over the seats.

name: National Stadium, Singapore
features: Thin steel dome spanning the whole bowl, with a retractable roof that slides shut for shade.

name: Vietnam National Convention Center
features: Long hall under a wave-shaped roof that rolls along the facade, echoing the sea.
